name: defectdojo-tests
description: UI + API + DB test automation for DefectDojo (vulnerability management platform). TypeScript + Playwright, three suites sharing src/shared.

scripts.db:wait: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); require('child_process').execSync('docker compose up -d defectdojo-db', {stdio:'inherit'}); const {Client}=require('pg'); const c=new Client({host:process.env.DD_DB_HOST||'localhost',port:Number(process.env.DD_DB_PORT||55432),user:process.env.DD_DB_USER||'defectdojo',password:process.env.DD_DB_PASSWORD||'defectdojo',database:process.env.DD_DB_NAME||'defectdojo'}); let i=0;(async()=>{while(i++<60){try{await c.connect();await c.query('SELECT 1');await c.end();console.log('DB ready');return;}catch{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));}}throw new Error('DB not ready after 60s');})();"
